svg.title: AREA 13
svg.desc: On both sides, use the right pad of each pair; left pads explode. Others wait by the exit gate. Alternate holding pads. Move only once the partner has crossed and holds the next pad; do not shuffle on a held pad. Take the north orange switch, then return through its open main-route barrier. The 1 branch takes its entrance bush pad, then returns via 2. The main team activates the other three switches. Use only the four marked locations: the entrance bushes on both sides, underwater, and the shore. Other hidden switches can explode. Traps await immediately past the four-switch door; clear them before crossing. The east cyan switch opens the last gate; the collector can take it on the way.
